title: Jesus Curses the Fig Tree
description: On the way from Bethany, Jesus became hungry and went to a fig tree with leaves, but found no fruit because it was not the season for figs. He said: 'May no one ever eat fruit from you again.' Early the next morning, the disciples discovered that the tree had withered from the roots, and Peter exclaimed: 'Rabbi, look! The fig tree you cursed has withered.'
